body:
# LarryCraft
An all-encompassing* modpack focused on exploration, adventure, fair difficulty, magic, and technology.</br></br>
**For the dedicated server compatible version see**: [https://modrinth.com/modpack/larrycraft-server](https://modrinth.com/modpack/larrycraft-server)</br></br>
**Requires Java 21 or newer. C2ME recommends Java 22 or newer for every optimization module. I recommend Java 25 due to it being on the LTS branch and is actively maintained.**

## Exploration
LarryCraft features many world generation mods adding various new and unique biomes, structures, mobs, and dimensions to Minecraft. Every adventure will feel new and unique.

## Adventure
There are new friendly and hostile mobs and many new expansive dungeons added to LarryCraft.

## Fair difficilty
LarryCraft is significantly harder than Vanilla Minecraft, with new survival mechanics, new hostile enemies, and time-scaling difficulty. LarryCraft will provide a challenge even for the most experienced player without feeling unfair.

## Magic
LarryCraft features multiple interconnected magic systems, from basic rune-powered spells to differing branches of witchcraft, any aspiring mage will feel at home.

## Technology
LarryCraft features an expansive technology and inustrial system allowing for automation of menial tasks, massive ships, space travel, and industrialization. Any tech wizard will have all the resources to let their imagination run wild.

## So much more!
There is much more to LarryCraft than a short description can provide, so why not take a look and see what you will find!

### Recommended hardware
Sata SSD or better with a good amount of free space.</br>
AMD Ryzen 5 3500 or equivalent or better.</br>
16GB DDR4 2400MHz RAM or better.</br>
Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060/GTX 1070Ti or equivalent or better.</br>
